terminals.name: api
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; export WAYSTONE_DB="$PWD/.devdata/arena.db"; export WAYSTONE_ADMIN_TOKEN=dev-admin-token; uv run waystone3 api-serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 9200

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh"; fi; cd frontend && npm run dev
